name: uxr-action-tracker
description: Builds a Research Action Tracker that records each recommendation with its owner, the owner's decision (do, park or reject with a reason), the dates, the linked evidence, a follow-up check and what changed in the product. Use for "run uxr-action-tracker", "research action tracker", "what did the last study change", "track research recommendations", "research impact log", "follow up on findings", "decision log for research", "nobody acted on the research", part of the UX Research with Claude Pack by 90n.
